rows.cause: Repeated investigation reached the writer report reserve without an edit. edit_file had been available in rounds 1–8; this was not a permission rejection.
Strict current_state rejected a superseded observation; no model request remained for a report correction.
66,908-character evidence context exceeded 50,000; generic exception handler misclassified capacity as source_changed. Offline replay found zero source mismatches.

Sender shortened excerpts while receiver still required the original 1,200-character prefix. Worker exited before its model factory; missing response retained runtime unknown. Provider observation had five known expert requests and no writer transport.

bounded_view_contract: Opt-in prefix length and version metadata; receiver validates each exact prefix against the immutable original. All full records remain restorable.
implementation_note: The final local handoff character cap is 32,000 instead of 16,000 only for the opt-in view; the existing complete-input 32K Token budget still applies.
offline_debug_note: The first offline replay reused an old public command wrapper and produced an unreferenced process receipt under that older scope. It was not used to score the real trial; later replay used an independent candidate and the unchanged public checker. Immutable raw-reference/results remain the scoring authority.
